tip_title: Hurricane Season Isn't Just a Home Insurance Problem. Your Auto Deductible Matters Too.
topic: Auto Insurance - Collision Deductible Review After Hurricane Season
blurb:
💡 **Insurance Tip: Hurricane Season Isn't Just a Home Insurance Problem. Your Auto Deductible Matters Too.**

Most people think about their home policy when storm season comes up. But September is peak hurricane season, and your car is just as exposed to wind, hail, falling trees, and flood water as your house is. Comprehensive coverage is what pays for that kind of non-collision damage on your vehicle — but the deductible you set on that coverage is money you'd have to come up with out of pocket before your insurer covers the rest. If you set that number three years ago and haven't thought about it since, it's worth pulling up your policy and checking whether it still makes sense for where you are financially right now.

Not sure what your current auto deductibles are or whether they still fit? Your Peachy agent can pull that up with you in a few minutes.

📖 [Learn more from the Insurance Information Institute](https://www.iii.org/article/how-much-life-insurance-do-i-need)
summary: Covers auto insurance comprehensive deductible review framed around peak hurricane season — specifically that storm damage to vehicles (hail, wind, flooding) falls under comprehensive coverage, and the deductible amount you set at inception may no longer match your current financial situation.
